full_name: Julie A. Shah | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Engineering & Computer Science Perrin Moorhead Grayson and Bruns Grayson Fellow Massachusetts Institute of Technology
bio: Julie A. Shah is an associate professor in the Department of Aeronautics and Astronautics at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, where she leads the Interactive Robotics Group of the Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory. Before joining the faculty, she worked at Boeing Research and Technology on robotics applications for aerospace manufacturing.
